verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a built-in AI Assistant inside the Connector Builder UI that can automatically prefill and configure connector fields and sections, so users can delegate part of connector setup. Its documented scope is limited to that one workflow, and the MCP and Airbyte Agents material covers external agents connecting to Airbyte, not an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant for tasks beyond connector building (e.g. connections, syncs, troubleshooting), depth on what tasks it can complete end-to-end, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder, drastically reducing setup time.
When starting a new connector, AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder
Connector Builder is a no-code tool that’s part of the Airbyte UI
